about_the_game:
Join our Discord for feedback!What is the White Room Protocol?

In White Room Protocol, you step into the mind of a subject undergoing an experimental memory-erasure program. Starting in a sterile white room, you're guided into Jesse’s most haunting memory — his childhood home — where something terrible happened.

Key Features

  • Fear builds through atmosphere and tension

  • Flashlight-based exploration with dynamic real-time lighting

  • Spine-chilling sound design and 3D spatial audio

  • Light puzzle-solving integrated into environmental storytelling

  • A scripted experience with reactive triggers and tension-driven pacing

  • A 15 minute demo designed to leave a lasting emotional impact

Gameplay Overview

Explore Jesse’s childhood home in first person — investigate his past, piece together hidden clues, and survive the horrors that resurface.
Interact with the world using smooth physics-based mechanics: open doors, drawers and cabinets, swtiching light sources, and interact with story driven objects to uncover memories.
But beware: you are not alone in this house. Something — or someone — is watching.

Are you ready to erase the past — or will the past erase you?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains scenes of psychological distress, mental trauma, and intense fear. The narrative includes references to domestic violence and the aftermath of a murder within a family setting. There are no depictions of sexual content or drug use.

Player discretion is advised due to scenes of emotional manipulation, self-blame, and unsettling hallucinations.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 7700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: A psychological first-person horror game where you enter a memory-erasing protocol and relive a trauma. Uncover dark secrets, and experience fear through immersive atmosphere.
